Aisha Khan: Quick async check for the Cordova Health renewal — doing a short standup thread so we can hand off later if needed.
Aisha Khan: Yesterday: ran the adoption playbook with the CSM, scheduled their integration review. Observed 12% drop in embed throughput after the change.
Aisha Khan: Blockers: customer saw delayed webhook retries and a billing question from procurement. Need eng help on retry errors and a one-line note for finance.
Marco Li: Procurement update: legal asked for data retention clause before signing. Finance needs a short note on data egress. Can someone draft? :thinking_face:
Janelle Park: On the webhook retries — saw increased 502s from our proxy between 08:00–10:30 UTC. I've got a mitigation PR ready, just need an extra review for the config toggle.
Janelle Park: PR: https://git.example/redwood/infra/pulls/482 :eyes:
Oliver Reed: For the billing note: short blurb ready, attaching here: "Redwood retains inference logs for 30 days by default; longer retention can be added via enterprise add-on." Want me to drop into the contract?
Sara M.: Yes please @Oliver Reed, drop it into section 5.2 and ping me when done.
IncidentsBot: alert: webhook-proxy error rate > 5% for service cordova-ingest (09:12 UTC)
Aisha Khan: Janelle can you paste the quick rollback command in thread so CS can run if needed?
Janelle Park: Rollback is one-liner: ```kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/proxy --to-revision=3```
Janelle Park: Also log query to confirm: ```logs tail --filter "service=cordova-ingest AND status=502" --since 3h```
Marco Li: I'll coordinate with procurement after Oliver drops the clause. Thanks.
Oliver Reed: Done — clause added and commented in the contract doc. Pinged @Sara M. :thumbsup:
Sara M.: Got it, will forward to legal.
Aisha Khan: Next actions: (1) @Janelle complete the PR review + toggle rollback plan, (2) @Oliver send clause to legal, (3) @Marco confirm procurement timeline. I'll follow up in the morning and open a brief handoff if any of these stay open.
Janelle Park: On it, aim to merge in the next 45m.
Marco Li: I'll have procurement ETA by EOD.
Aisha Khan: Thanks all. If anyone needs async context: summary saved in the CS playbook page -> https://confluence.example/redwood/cordova-health-playbook :books:
